value.rationale: Addresses a natural ecological transition where the baseline Gamma shape switches from low-abundance peak to positive mode. Small immigration produces a non-Lipschitz fractional-power perturbation below the boundary, a logarithmic critical one, and a regular perturbation above; the exact signed-deficit distributions identify abundances that respond, informing interpretation of abundance time series and near-extinction sampling. No unrelated arbitrary cutoff is chosen.
